name: Sand Eaters
description:
About This Game

Disclaimer: Sand Eaters is currently under development. All Steam content is not final.

ENGAGE. EXTERMINATE. EVOLVE.

Sand Eaters is a high-octane, dark sci-fi co-op shooter designed for players who live for the perfect loadout and the heat of a relentless firefight. In an oppressive universe of brutalist machinery, your survival depends on your ability to outgun and out-adapt a rising tide of mechanical horrors.

A DEVASTATING MODULAR ARSENAL

Build your playstyle from the ground up with a massive array of weaponry and tech-augments.

  • Deep Customization: Don't just pick a gun—engineer it. Modify your loadout to prioritize raw stopping power, tactical utility, or agile precision.

  • Synergistic Build-crafting: Mix and match augments that change how your gear behaves, allowing for thousands of potential build combinations.

  • Tactile Gunplay: Every weapon is tuned for high-impact feedback, ensuring that every trigger pull feels heavy, powerful, and lethal.

ADAPTIVE THREATS AND EVOLVING ENEMIES

The machines you face are not static. As you progress, the enemy forces evolve, deploying new tactics, armor types, and lethal weapons to counter your playstyle. You’ll need to constantly iterate on your strategy and gear to survive encounters that grow in complexity and intensity.

EXPLORE A CHANGING FRONTIER

Fight through high-fidelity environments defined by industrial decay and dark sci-fi aesthetics. From sprawling atmospheric factories to claustrophobic derelict stations, the world of Sand Eaters is as dangerous as the enemies within it. Every zone is designed to challenge your mastery of the combat sandbox.

KEY FEATURES

  • Brutal Co-op Action: Squad up with friends to tackle overwhelming odds where coordination is the difference between survival and termination.

  • Deep Build Crafting: A systems-heavy progression model that rewards players who spend time perfecting their "instrument."

  • Evolving AI Systems: Experience a dynamic difficulty curve where enemies learn and adapt to your squad's capabilities.

  • Visceral Combat Loop: Fast-paced, high-stakes gunplay in a world that respects your skill and punishes your mistakes.
short_desc: Sand Eaters is a sci-fi co-op shooter. Define your playstyle through deep customization—from lightweight speed demons to heavy armored gunners. Deploy lethal units called "Instruments" to battle evolving threats across hostile regions.
